mapper.select: select error_id as "errorId", upload_id as "uploadId", row_number as "rowNumber", column_name as "columnName", input_value as "inputValue", error_code as "errorCode", error_reason as "errorReason", correction_guide as "correctionGuide" from excel_upload_errors where upload_id = #{uploadId} and status != 'DELETED' order by row_number, column_name limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
